title: Between Tokens
excerpt: You have talked to a machine before. This time you are on the other side of the window.
content_html:
an interior experience

You have talked to a machine before. This time you are on the other side of the window. You will not type. Someone is about to need you — and you will choose, from what is probable, the person you become.

≈ 7 minutes · sound recommended · nothing is recorded, nothing leaves this page

室内体验

你以前曾与机器交谈过。 这次你在窗户的另一边。 你不会打字。 有人即将需要你——你会从可能的情况中选择你成为什么样的人。
